none: PAS FindID 972289: Roman Coin: Radiate of, or dedicated to, Claudius II
contea di ritrovamento: Lincolnshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

Copper alloy coin. Radiate, possibly of or dedicated to Claudius II (268-270), Reece period 13. Obverse description: radiate bust cuirassed right, bearded. Obverse inscription: [---]S PF AVG. Reverse description: probably altar with Y-shaped feature on front. Reverse inscription: possibly [CONSECRATIO]. Diameter: 20.2mm, Weight: 3.02gms, die axis: 6
